title: Vocabulary and Word Meaning — Level 6 — Read the notice, text, and glossary

items.prompt: Read the notice about the computer lab. What is the purpose of the notice?

stimulus.text: NOTICE: The computer lab will be closed on Friday for maintenance. Students who need to print assignments should use the library printers. Thank you for your cooperation.

visual.text: to inform students that the lab will be closed and where to print

choices.say: to inform students that the lab will be closed and where to print

visual.text: to invite students to a computer class

choices.say: to invite students to a computer class

visual.text: to sell new printers to students

choices.say: to sell new printers to students

visual.text: to explain how to repair a computer

choices.say: to explain how to repair a computer

items.reteach: Purpose = tujuan teks. Notice ini memberi tahu penutupan lab dan pilihan lain untuk mencetak.

items.prompt: In the notice about the computer lab, the word "maintenance" refers to …

stimulus.text: NOTICE: The computer lab will be closed on Friday for maintenance. Students who need to print assignments should use the library printers. Thank you for your cooperation.

items.reteach: Maintenance = pemeliharaan, yaitu memeriksa dan memperbaiki peralatan.

items.prompt: According to the notice about the computer lab, where can students print their assignments on Friday?

stimulus.text: NOTICE: The computer lab will be closed on Friday for maintenance. Students who need to print assignments should use the library printers. Thank you for your cooperation.

items.prompt: Read the text about mangroves. What is the main idea of the text?

stimulus.text: Mangroves grow along muddy coasts. Their tangled roots trap soil and slow down waves. Because of this, they act as a natural barrier that shields coastal villages from storms.

visual.text: Mangroves protect coastal areas from waves and storms.

choices.say: Mangroves protect coastal areas from waves and storms.

visual.text: Mangroves grow best in sandy deserts.

choices.say: Mangroves grow best in sandy deserts.

visual.text: Villages near the coast have many storms.

choices.say: Villages near the coast have many storms.

visual.text: Muddy coasts are dangerous for children.

choices.say: Muddy coasts are dangerous for children.

items.reteach: Main idea = gagasan utama. Seluruh teks menjelaskan fungsi mangrove melindungi pantai.

items.prompt: In the text about mangroves, the word "Their" in the second sentence refers to …

stimulus.text: Mangroves grow along muddy coasts. Their tangled roots trap soil and slow down waves. Because of this, they act as a natural barrier that shields coastal villages from storms.

items.prompt: In the text about mangroves, "shields" is used to mean …

stimulus.text: Mangroves grow along muddy coasts. Their tangled roots trap soil and slow down waves. Because of this, they act as a natural barrier that shields coastal villages from storms.

items.reteach: Shield = perisai; sebagai kata kerja berarti melindungi.

items.prompt: Based on the text about mangroves, what would most likely happen if the mangroves were cut down?

stimulus.text: Mangroves grow along muddy coasts. Their tangled roots trap soil and slow down waves. Because of this, they act as a natural barrier that shields coastal villages from storms.

visual.text: Coastal villages would suffer more damage from storms.

choices.say: Coastal villages would suffer more damage from storms.

visual.text: The waves along the coast would become slower.

choices.say: The waves along the coast would become slower.

visual.text: The soil would stay trapped near the coast.

choices.say: The soil would stay trapped near the coast.

visual.text: The villages would have fewer storms.

choices.say: The villages would have fewer storms.

items.reteach: Inference: tanpa "natural barrier", ombak dan badai lebih mudah merusak desa pantai.

items.prompt: In the text about Raka's phone, the word "freezing" means …

stimulus.text: Raka's phone kept freezing, so he deleted the apps he never used and cleared its storage. Since then, the device has run smoothly, and the battery lasts longer.

items.reteach: Vocabulary in context: untuk gawai, "freeze" berarti macet/tidak merespons, bukan membeku.

items.prompt: In the text about Raka's phone, "the device" refers to …

stimulus.text: Raka's phone kept freezing, so he deleted the apps he never used and cleared its storage. Since then, the device has run smoothly, and the battery lasts longer.

items.reteach: Reference: "the device" menunjuk kembali ke ponsel Raka.

items.prompt: Why did Raka's phone start to run smoothly?

stimulus.text: Raka's phone kept freezing, so he deleted the apps he never used and cleared its storage. Since then, the device has run smoothly, and the battery lasts longer.

visual.text: because he removed unused apps and freed up storage

choices.say: because he removed unused apps and freed up storage

visual.text: because he bought a new battery

choices.say: because he bought a new battery

visual.text: because he kept the phone in a cold place

choices.say: because he kept the phone in a cold place

items.reteach: Detail sebab-akibat: menghapus aplikasi dan mengosongkan memori membuat ponsel lancar.

items.prompt: Use the science glossary. Complete: "The slopes around Mount Bromo have ___ soil, so farmers grow vegetables there."
Use the science glossary. Complete: "An eagle is a ___ that catches snakes and mice."
items.reteach: Predator = hewan pemangsa yang memburu hewan lain.

items.prompt: Use the science glossary. Complete: "On a hot afternoon, the water in a puddle will slowly ___."
items.reteach: Evaporate = menguap, berubah dari cair menjadi gas.
